# awsh

> Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.

A shell has exactly one response to a line it does not recognise: command not found. So the moment you want to look something up you leave the terminal for a browser and lose the directory, the environment and the session you were already in -- when everything needed to answer you was right there.

## Install

```
npm i -g @aitherium/awsh
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Type a question at your prompt and get an answer instead of "command not found".

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awfind](https://aitherium.github.io/awfind/) — A portable search client — query, results, ranking.
- [awbrowse](https://aitherium.github.io/awbrowse/) — A portable browser client — navigate, console, network, DOM, screenshot.
- [awembed](https://aitherium.github.io/awembed/) — Train an embedding model that knows your corpus, and prove it beats the big one.
- [awdesk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdesk/) — Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.
- [awvoice](https://aitherium.github.io/awvoice/) — Hear and speak — transcribe audio, synthesize a voice.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awsh
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awsh.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
